mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may lower seizure threshold and reduce brivaracetam efficacy; brivaracetam may increase CNS depressant effects in context of amphotericin B-induced metabolic complications.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and seizure control closely; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly and consider alternative antifungal if possible.
